[EN] Eliminate Thulsa's Cavalry Brigade

[EN] This isn't the end!

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate Cursed Legion dragoons and their leader near Firebase Audacity.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Karrteh at Firebase Audacity.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
